definition: For every candidate group in data/evidence/candidate-observations.json with 2+ candidates carrying genuinely independent evidence lineages, records which candidate was selected/rejected, the selection method, confidence and rationale. No decision here may resolve a conflict by unlabelled averaging.

decisions.rationale: The reconciliation condition ('reconcile additive totals where meaningful') fails decisively and non-uniformly, not merely by an acceptable rounding/vintage margin. This means the 'C'-prefixed RID_8 codes in the only publicly downloadable classified road GIS layer found do not correspond reliably to KeRRA's current official Class C classification underlying KNBS Table 11.9. Building a constituency breakdown on this input would misrepresent individual constituencies by up to an order of magnitude (worst case, two orders of magnitude for Nairobi), which is precisely the kind of fabricated-precision outcome the Atlas's anti-fabrication rule exists to prevent. No defensible spatial_derivation is currently possible for this indicator at constituency level.
decisions.resulting_disposition: official county value published unchanged; the derived candidate was rejected outright (not published as a probable S4 value), and constituency/ward-level spatial derivation for the same indicator remains governed_unavailable rather than being built on a candidate that failed reconciliation by up to two orders of magnitude
